title: feat(plugin-detail): say when a record:activity types entry names a feed kind nothing produces
body:
Fixes #5877

Direction 3 only, per triage: make the emptiness **diagnosable**. Neither the published enum nor any producer is touched — `FeedItemType` is `@objectstack/spec`'s type, re-exported at `packages/types/src/views.ts:355`, and its membership is another repo's and another seat's.

## What was wrong

`types: ['approval']` parsed, typechecked, built, and rendered a permanently empty timeline with nothing said anywhere. The sibling diagnostic already in this block only reports entries it cannot *recognise*, and `approval` is a perfectly well-spelled declared kind — so an author, or an AI writing the metadata, reads the result as a working feature that happens to have no data yet. Declared surface, enforced by nothing.

## What changed

One deduped `console.warn` per distinct kind, on its own channel beside the two `types` / `filterMode` diagnostics already in `recordActivityFeed.ts`. **The entry is still honoured exactly as authored — nothing that renders changes.** It is a diagnostic, not a refusal.

## The census, re-derived (the card body's was stale by dispatch)

**Pathspec bound, stated rather than implied:** every `.ts` / `.tsx` file under the repository root at every top level — `packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/`, `scripts/`, `e2e/` — excluding build output and tests, narrowed to files that mention `FeedItem` at all (a necessary condition for constructing one), then read for `FeedItemType` literals. **1622 non-test files scanned, 13 mention `FeedItem`, exactly one produces a kind off the activity map.** Measured on merge-base `e3d117ae1`.

| kind | producer |
|---|---|
| `field_change` | `sys_activity` `created` / `updated` / `deleted` / `assigned` / `shared` |
| `task` | `sys_activity` `completed` |
| `event` | `sys_activity` `scheduled` |
| `system` | `sys_activity` `system`, **plus** `UNMAPPED_ACTIVITY_FEED_TYPE` — reachable from any author-extended type |
| `comment` | `sys_comment` rows, built by `RecordDetailView` and handed over through `DiscussionContext` |

**Eight with no producer:** `email`, `call`, `note`, `file`, `record_create`, `record_delete`, `approval`, `sharing`.

**Delta against the card body's eight: zero.** The body already counted `system` as produced (via `sys_activity.type = 'system'`), so PR #6112 did not move it out of a set it was never in — what #6112 changed is the *reason*: `system` is now reachable from **any** author-extended type, and that fallback exists so an unclassified value reports a missing decision rather than vanishing. A warn that fired on `system` would contradict a deliberate design, and a test pins that it does not.

**Does the census count the third reading? No, and explicitly so.** `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` / `layout/activityItemType.ts` read the same `sys_activity` rows but produce `ActivityItemType` — `create` / `update` / `delete` / `comment` / `system`, a **five**-value vocabulary since #6730 landed, not the four the dispatch order recorded. It is not a projection of `FeedItemType` in either direction, and a row it maps never becomes a `FeedItem`, so it produces nothing for this feed. Out of scope: #6730, not converged here. The exclusion is asserted in the census test rather than assumed, so it cannot become vacuous. `ActivityEntry` in `@object-ui/types` is a third vocabulary again and has no producer at all.

## Three populations, not two — and the honest limitation

A warn that reports deliberate non-adoption as a defect trains authors to ignore the channel, so the message keeps them apart:

- **produced** — silent.
- **deliberately unadopted** (`record_create`, `record_delete`, `sharing`) — reported as *a decision rather than a gap*, with the reason: those rows map to `field_change` on purpose, because the record page and this block must agree what a `created` row **is** before either can move to the richer kind.
- **no producer, no recorded decision** — reported as exactly that. The message stops there rather than calling it a gap.

**Is the distinction machine-reachable? Not by derivation — and the implementation says so out loud.** The decision exists only as prose in `ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE`'s doc comment, and a comment is not machine-readable. `DELIBERATELY_UNADOPTED_FEED_TYPES` is a **transcription** of that prose, documented as one, with two consequences written into the code: it is edited together with the prose it was copied from, and a kind *absent* from it is not thereby known to be an oversight. That is why the third population's wording is "whether that is a gap or a decision nobody wrote down is not recorded anywhere this diagnostic can read" — no heuristic was invented to guess.

The message also names what no census taken here can bound: **a host that supplies the feed itself** (`items` on the node, or its own `DiscussionContext`) can produce kinds this repository cannot see.

## Anti-drift

`PRODUCED_FEED_TYPES` is **derived** from the producers — the map's range plus its fallback — so giving a kind a producer retires its diagnostic in the same edit. The one producer that cannot be derived (`comment`, in app-shell, which depends on this package rather than the other way round) is declared, and `feedTypeProducerCensus-5877.test.ts` re-runs the census over the repository. That test asserts the scan's **width** as well as its result — repo root present, more than 1000 files walked, every top level reached, the known cross-package producer found — because every other assertion in it is of the form "the scan found nothing the census missed", which a silently narrowed pathspec satisfies trivially.

## Verification

All at final commit `0454ea706`, exit codes captured before any pipe.

**Both directions, with controls** — a one-directional test would let a warn-on-everything implementation pass:

- an unproduced kind warns — asserted for the card's own example **and, one at a time, for every member of the derived unproduced set**;
- a produced kind does **not** warn — asserted for each of the five individually and as a list;
- the two `types` channels stay separate (a mixed list yields two warnings, not one);
- the entry is returned as authored, so this is a diagnostic and not a refusal.

**vitest, root form, over the affected package** (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`) — the repo's guard refuses the `--filter` forms:

| | Test Files | Tests | on-disk `*.test.*` in the package |
|---|---|---|---|
| before (`e3d117ae1`, comparison worktree) | 115 passed (115) | 1053 passed (1053) | 115 |
| after (`0454ea706`) | 116 passed (116) | 1070 passed (1070) | 116 |

Delta is exactly this PR's additions (+1 file, +17 tests), and the reported file count equals the target package's own on-disk count in both runs — the sanity check against a form that silently runs another package's files.

**Ablation, direction predicted in writing before the run.** The **fact** was mutated, not an assertion: one entry added to `ACTIVITY_TYPE_TO_FEED_TYPE` (`approved: 'approval'`), giving the unproduced kind `approval` a producer. Anchor uniqueness asserted before writing (`grep -Fc` = 1, landing site `recordActivityFeed.ts:133`); injected and anchor text grepped separately; `git hash-object` moved `5ab2ef32b` to `ea2111ca5`. No rebuild is required and that is a property of this pair rather than an assumption — the tests import `../recordActivityFeed` by relative path and the root vitest config aliases every `@object-ui/*` specifier to `packages/*/src`, so no `dist/` is on either resolution path.

Predicted 6 red, got 8; the two extras are the same class, one test of mine missed in the enumeration and one **pre-existing** map pin (`leaves every mapped type pointing where it did`) whose red is the strongest evidence the mutation hit the fact. **And the warn stopped for that kind alone:** the control that loops the derived unproduced set stayed green with its remaining seven members still warning, the control over the derived produced set stayed green with `approval` now silent in it, and the mutated run's own message reads `... selects nothing: "sharing" ... Feed item types ObjectUI produces today: approval, comment, event, field_change, system, task`. Restore proven both ways under `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` with absolute paths from `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, via `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`: `git diff HEAD` empty for the file, and hash back to `5ab2ef32b` = the HEAD blob.

**Gates**, each printing its own verdict:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check` (hyphenated; echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the new test files are type-checked rather than excluded) — exit 0
- `pnpm exec eslint .` in `packages/plugin-detail`, plain form — exit 0, `880 problems (0 errors, 880 warnings)`, none of them in a file this PR touches
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — exit 0, `3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` — exit 0 each

**Declared narrowing, so it is a measurement and not a silence.** `check:readme-exports` and `check:doc-snippets` were **not measured**: both refuse on an unbuilt workspace (`check:doc-snippets` exits 2 with `PRECONDITION NOT MET — The snippet program was NOT run`, and says so itself), and this worktree built only the target's dependency closure. Neither can be affected by this diff — it touches no README, no package barrel and adds no fenced code block. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` farm is CI's run.

## Out of scope, filed rather than fixed

- #6932 — two statements in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` are stale: unmapped rows are no longer *dropped*, and the callout about a second hand-written copy of the table describes a hazard #5896 removed.
- #6933 — `ObjectView.tsx` imports the `FeedItem` type and never uses it (a false positive this very census had to reject by hand).

Both unassigned, for triage.
